notes.title: Language Update — Spanish and Portuguese Added!
notes.notes: [p]We’re happy to announce that Spanish and Portuguese languages have been added to [i]Lost Infinity[/i].[/p]

notes.title: Update: Lost Infinity is now available in Japanese and Korean!
notes.notes: [p][b]What’s new in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full text localization into Japanese and Korean[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update: The game is now available in Chinese!
notes.notes:
[p]We're happy to announce that [i]Lost Infinity[/i] now supports Simplified Chinese!
This is an important step for us, and we hope players from China will enjoy immersing themselves in the atmosphere of our story.[/p][p]
[b]What's new in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full text localization into Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Sincerely,
Void Echo[/p]

notes.title: The release of Lost Infinity
notes.notes:
[p]We are pleased to announce the release of our game![/p][p]If you choose to purchase our game, we are sincerely grateful for your support.
Every purchase helps us continue doing what we love — creating games.[/p][p]Sincerely,
[b]Void Echo[/b][/p]

notes.title: The game comes out on July 12!
notes.notes: [p]The release of our game is coming very soon.[/p][p]We will be very grateful if you appreciate the demo version and purchase the game by its release![/p][previewyoutube="SFQ5H55m3E8;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Lost Infinity demo is available now!
notes.notes:
We present you the demo version of our visual novel.

The release of the full version will be very soon, but in the meantime you can pass this demo and add the game to your wishlist!

[b]Void Echo team[/b]
